# `mise backends ls`

- **用法：** `mise backends ls`
- **别名：** `list`
- **效果：** 只读
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/backends/ls.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/backends/ls.rs)

列出内置后端

Backends that plugins add are listed by `mise plugins ls`.

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## 示例

List the backends built into mise

```
mise backends ls
```
